common_support: retain original hard relation row iff all three saved control sets have >=1 valid individual; retain query iff >=1 such row; same queries AND hard rows in every comparison
weights: equal hard slots/query, queries/image, available images/verified512parent, available parents; split each random relation weight equally over its saved available controls
fixed_class_weights: 49 query-pseudoclass x candidate-pseudoclass cells; pool hard and primary-random hierarchical masses 1:1; restrict to cells observed in hard and every random view; normalize ONCE and use same weights for both groups and all views
unmatched_cells: report all 49 cells and excluded probability mass; never impute absent means as zero
decomposition: raw difference = within + composition + unilateral-support contribution; symmetric within=sum((pH+pR)/2*(muH-muR)), composition=sum((muH+muR)/2*(pH-pR)); only bilateral cells; unilateral terms reported separately; descriptive not causal

bootstrap.unit: all128 verified512 parents with all children retained; same parent draws across groups and controls
bootstrap.fixed_weights: retain original fixed cell weights in every replicate; if any positive-weight cell missing either group, whole standardized replicate is undefined; report count and conditional interval, no per-replicate weight renormalization

similarity: reuse saved soft7 cosine; no recomputation or alternative metric selection
